subject: Renewal + expansion: proposal for 12mo renewal, phased price hold & bridging credit
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Eve Johnson <eve.johnson@vendora.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + expansion: initial proposal and meeting request

Eve —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Vendora's usage spike during the holiday test was a great stress test and we think there’s a straightforward renewal path that secures runway for you while keeping unit economics stable. High level proposal:

- Term: 12 months from 2027-01-01
- Commit: baseline commit bumped to 1.5x current monthly run-rate for first 90 days to cover expected holiday uplift, returning to 1.2x thereafter (phased commit).
- Price: hold current per-token rates for the first 6 months (phased price hold), then step down to a 3% discount off current public rates for the remaining term.
- Bridging credit: $60,000 applied as onboarding/service credit across first two invoices to offset migration/ingestion costs.
- Operational: 99.9% SLA, access to a dedicated support cohort for the migration window; optional burst pool for peak days.

Can we schedule 30 minutes tomorrow to walk through the numbers with procurement/finance? If the above looks directionally right I’ll draft an amendment and include the credit mechanics.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: none
From: Eve Johnson <eve.johnson@vendora.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: initial proposal and meeting request

Ben —

Thanks — that direction sounds promising. A couple things procurement needs to confirm before we lock a date:

1) Can you confirm the exact billing cadence if we take the phased commit (monthly invoices vs quarterly?). We prefer quarterly invoicing aligned to our internal cadence.
2) Need a written explanation of the $60k credit mechanics (how it appears on invoices, whether it's refundable or only applied as service credits).
3) SOC 2 evidence — please confirm where to find the latest report.
4) Pricing hold: are you able to guarantee the current rates for 6 months across all models included in our catalog, or does it exclude specific add-ons?

I’ve attached Vendora_PO_Request.pdf with our standard procurement fields to help speed things. Alan (procurement) looped here.

Eve
Eve Johnson
Head of Procurement, Vendora, Inc.
Eve.Johnson@vendora.com | +1 212-555-0199

Team — forwarding Vendora's PO template and their questions. Quick asks:

- Monica/Marissa: can you draft a mutual action plan (MAP) that shows milestone-based onboarding (data ingest, KV warm-up, canary traffic) tied to the $60k bridging credit being applied across first two invoices? I want the credit to offset SRE migration work and ingestion costs.
- Marissa: confirm the operational support cohort and whether we can commit to a dedicated onboarding engineer for the first 30 days.
- Marcus/legal: need a short amendment that:
   * Specifies the 12mo term and the phased commit schedule (1.5x for first 90 days -> 1.2x after).
   * Locks current rates for 6 months specifically for the listed model SKUs, excluding optional add-ons (clarify definition).
   * Describes credit mechanics (non-refundable service credit applied to invoices until exhausted).

Eve/procurement asked for quarterly invoicing as a preference — ops/finance will need to confirm that cadence.

I’ve put a placeholder HubSpot note (link below) and will include the draft amendment once legal gives the green light.

Eve / Alan —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching the PO template. Per our internal alignment (Monica/Marissa/Marcus), here is the revised proposal addressing procurement points:

- Term & commit: 12-month amendment effective 2027-01-01. Billing cadence: quarterly in arrears (we’ll consolidate monthly usage into a single quarterly invoice to match Vendora).
- Commit profile: first 90 days we’ll set the committed monthly baseline at 1.5x current monthly run-rate; after day 90 the baseline steps to 1.2x for the remainder of the term. True-ups will occur on quarterly invoice dates.
- Price hold & SKUs: We will hold current per-token rates for six months for the core model SKUs used in your production workloads (list to be appended in the amendment). Optional add-ons (dedicated burst pool, premium SRE days beyond the dedicated cohort) are excluded and will be quoted separately.
- Bridging credit mechanics: $60,000 non-refundable service credit applied to your first two quarterly invoices until exhausted. Credit will appear as a line item "Bridging Credit (Vendora)" and reduce the invoice balance; it is not eligible for refund but will fully offset Redwood charges until depleted.
- SOC 2: latest SOC 2 Type II report is stored here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED_SOC2 (we’ll provide a secure binder to procurement).

Next steps: I’ve attached Renewal_Amendment_v2.pdf (draft amendment) with the MAP appended and the SKU list placeholder. If this looks good to Vendora legal/procurement I can send the DocuSign to sign (link below).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/renewal/DEAL-7832
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-7832

Would you like a short call Thursday to review the amendment line-by-line before we route to signatures?

Ben
